{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for other common sentinel values or invalid entries
# Look for -999.0 in the column as string or float
print("Values in biomarker_final that are -999.0:", df[df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0])

# Replace -999.0 with NaN for safety

# Now check for NaN
print("Number of NaNs after replacement:", df_clean['biomarker_final'].isna().sum())
